sentence: The room's organizing--assembling Tama from a shared pixel map and template, defending and repairing it (P05, P06), bargaining, relocating and rebuilding with neighbours (P08, P10, P16), answering joint-defence calls (P17), staging April Fools jokes under K01, celebrating, recording and keeping the work (P11-P13), its monster-poem running joke under K04, and revising the finished picture (P02)--restates in the model's terms with the arrows among R01, P01-P05, P08, P10-P13, P16, P17, K01 and K04, and none of the unused concepts it rests on--template links (c0010), sabotage tracing (c0067), player recruitment through the mark (c0082), the +297 addition (c0133), the space-short rainbow egg (c0153), newcomer questions about the canvas (c0170) and the header record (c0174)--shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts, the questions, recruitment and pre-loss spot choice being covered by the candidate entries P24, P25 and P27.
